column2:
Create a meeting agenda template for my [type of meeting — e.g., "weekly team standup," "monthly client review," "quarterly planning session"].

Attendees: [who]. Duration: [time].
Include:
(1) Pre-meeting: what attendees should prepare/review before the meeting,
(2) Agenda items with time allocations — be specific, not "discuss updates" but "each person shares: top win, biggest blocker, focus for this week (2 min each)," (3) Discussion framework — how to handle topics that go off track or over time,
(4) Decisions section — a place to document decisions made,
(5) Action items section — who, what, by when,
(6) Parking lot — topics to revisit later. Also include ground rules (e.g., cameras on, no phones, one speaker at a time, [your rules]).
Make this a template I can copy-paste every [frequency].
